INSIGHT: The root cause of 155 memories (15 unique concepts) was curator seeing only the session transcript, never the existing memory store
FIX: buildExistingMemoriesContext() builds compact list of active memories grouped by type, passed to every curation call
IMPLEMENTED IN: src/core/engine.ts (buildExistingMemoriesContext, getStore), src/core/curator.ts (existingMemories param on all curation methods), src/server/index.ts (builds context before each curation call)
CURATOR PROMPT ADDITION: Deduplication rules section with existing memories list — 'If new information UPDATES an existing memory, output supersedes field. Only extract genuinely NEW information.'
CROSS-SEGMENT: Accumulated headlines passed forward to subsequent segments as 'Already extracted' context
WHY DETERMINISTIC MANAGER: LLM manager was unreliable second point of failure. Three simple rules catch what curator misses without randomness.
